mission_07: No single outlier detection method works best for all datasets and scenarios. Each method has strengths and weaknesses: IQR is robust but univariate, Z-score assumes normality, Isolation Forest handles high dimensions well, DBSCAN finds density-based clusters, and LOF detects local anomalies in varying density regions. A systematic comparison using precision, recall, and F1 score reveals which method is most appropriate for a given dataset. Precision measures how many detected outliers are true outliers (avoiding false alarms), recall measures how many true outliers are found (avoiding misses), and F1 balances both. This comparative approach is essential in production systems where the cost of false positives and false negatives must be carefully weighed. The best method depends on the data distribution, outlier characteristics, and the specific requirements of the application.
